sources.title: IMAP Protocol Connection Pool Management
key_points: Non-Office 365 accounts (such as Gmail, IMAP, and SMTP accounts) repeatedly requested sign-in each time the New Outlook for Windows was opened or restarted.

Troubleshooting steps like clearing Windows Credential Manager, removing registry keys, deleting local AppData/Roaming folders, and clearing local state via command-line did not resolve the reauth loops for IMAP/SMTP accounts.
Classic Outlook did not exhibit the repeated sign-in prompts for the same IMAP accounts.
